description: POST /v1/reduction-sessions (§4.10 route 2, identity spec §6.4 route 2, DEC-2117): the reduction-session challenge it answers and the authenticator's assertion for it. The passkey is found by passkey_id alone, so a discoverable passkey and a non-discoverable one whose id the client supplies both serve (DEC-833). Every refusal is the one 401.
